intended use: Alternative "WetSand" layer: realistic grey-brown photoscanned damp sand (darker than Ground092B).

notes: nor_gl is OpenGL convention (+Y up); for Unreal flip the green channel. rough/ao are separate linear maps (no ARM pack in this set; sRGB off). Attribution is not required by CC0; credit kept voluntarily.
